# Settings from the palette (Rex's Change Terminal Font…, Change Theme…):
# a picker lists a setting's choices, each tried out in every window as
# it's selected; Return writes it to the config, Esc puts it back. Runs
# with a config folder of its own (@CFG@): font-size = 14, theme =
# probe-theme (background #112233).
expect-font:14
expect-background:#112233
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:change terminal font size
wait:0.3
expect-palette:Change Terminal Font Size… · 14 pt
key:enter
wait:0.4
# It starts on the size in use; the next one down is tried at once.
key:down
wait:0.4
expect-font:15
key:down
wait:0.4
expect-font:16
# Esc: back as it was, and to the list.
key:escape
wait:0.4
expect-font:14
expect-palette:Change Terminal Font Size…
# Again, and Return keeps it: written to the config.
key:enter
wait:0.4
key:down
wait:0.3
key:down
wait:0.3
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect-font:16
type:grep -c '^font-size = 16$' @CFG@/config && echo KEPT-IN-FILE
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:KEPT-IN-FILE
# A theme tried out: the windows take it; Esc and closing put it back.
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:change theme
wait:0.3
key:enter
wait:0.4
# Typing narrows the themes; the first that's left is tried.
type:libertty dark
wait:0.5
expect-palette:Libertty Dark
expect-background:#1c1c1e
key:escape
wait:0.4
expect-background:#112233
key:escape
wait:0.4
